name: Evelyn
source: Your childhood friend, and the one most unchanged by time. Evelyn offers warmth, familiarity, and a sense of safety that feels almost too intact. She remembers things others don’t mention, and sometimes reacts as if she’s already heard your answers. Being around her feels comforting… until it doesn’t.
